description: Commerce Assurance: submit a counterparty onboarding packet: legal or agent identity, contact, wallet or bank payment route, terms acceptance and compliance fields as supplied, with optional requirements (terms version, compliance fields). The signed report checks completeness and internal consistency: email, phone and website formats, the wallet format or the IBAN, SWIFT/BIC and routing formats, the account holder against the legal name, the terms version and date, and compliance dates and open statuses. Verdict complete, incomplete or inconsistent. Research on the counterparty itself is wever_counterparty-brief. POST /api/counterparty-onboarding-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no counterparty contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/commerce-assurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
